verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no SOC 2 reports, compliance attestations, trust center, data-handling or residency policies, or datacenter tier ratings that a platform engineer could use to verify CoreWeave's compliance posture. The available material describes security architecture features, such as DPU isolation, per-cluster VPCs, and API token authentication. Those are adjacent controls, not verifiable compliance evidence, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
